verdict.rationale: Bevy's first-party docs state it is open source under the permissive MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses with no contracts, no license fees and no sales cuts. The crates.io probe independently confirms the 'MIT OR Apache-2.0' license, and community comments praise the no-strings MIT licensing. This covers permissiveness, no royalties and no per-install fees.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the license is permissive with no royalties or per-install fees — I keep what my game earns

citations.quote: Open Source under the permissive MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses
It is free and open-source forever under your choice of the MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses.
MIT License, well done! It's so refreshing to see things released with no strings attached
